rows.text: walks the list whose head qword is `02E9FD60` (each node links on to qword `+8`) for the node equal to `rcx` and, when it finds it, stores that node's qword `+8` into the head or the predecessor's `+8` and zeroes it; then, for dword `+0x20` with qword `+0x28` and for dword `+0x10` with qword `+0x18`, calls (`006D5940` + 0x74, + 0x96 respectively) with the qword when bit 31 of the dword is clear and the qword is non-null, and zeroes the qword and the dword in either case

notes: 006D5940: the list compare is (node + 8) against (rcx + 8), i.e. node equal to rcx; the cmove to null inside the loop cannot fire because the loop exits on a null link. Both release calls go to the same callee.
